claims: Yaxel Lendeborg is a 6'9" forward for the Michigan Wolverines.
Yaxel Lendeborg was born in Puerto Rico on September 30, 2002.
Yaxel Lendeborg is of Dominican descent.
Yaxel Lendeborg moved to Ohio at age two.
Yaxel Lendeborg settled in Pennsauken, New Jersey, at age eight.
Yaxel Lendeborg considers Pennsauken, New Jersey, his hometown.
Yaxel Lendeborg played high school basketball at Pennsauken High School.
Yaxel Lendeborg's parents are Okary Lendeborg and Yissel Raposo.
Okary Lendeborg was a basketball player for the Dominican Republic national team.
Yissel Raposo was a basketball player for the Dominican Republic national team.
Yaxel Lendeborg attended Arizona Western College.
Yaxel Lendeborg has often cited his mother as a major influence.
Yaxel Lendeborg and his mother worked together in a warehouse after high school before his basketball career took off.
